test_gaussian_privatizer: test the gaussian_privatizer function to add Gaussian noise to JAX arrays with configurable standard deviation
test_matrix_factorization_privatizer: test the matrix_factorization_privatizer function to add correlated noise using a dense noising matrix
test_streaming_matrix_factorization_priv: test the streaming_matrix_factorization_privatizer function to add correlated noise using a streaming matrix like momentum SGD
test_optax_chain: test chaining a privatizer with an optax optimizer like adamw to produce noisy gradient updates
test_scale_invariance: test that scaling the noising matrix by stddev and setting stddev to 1.0 produces equivalent noise output
